# @loom/plugin-sentinel

The perpetual-agent pattern as one declaration (DX-1, db-copilot infra): sentinelPreset() bundles the schedule, contract-migratable carry state (@loom/plugin-durable-state), claim-checked telemetry (@loom/middleware), and the K10.6 pin policy — the five files of the db-sentinel example's harness, composition-time only (ADR 0043/0044).

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-sentinel`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
